title: OpenAPI schema remains exposed when debug docs are disabled
remediation: Disable openapi_url outside debug or require developer auth. Fixed in fix/application-security-hardening by disabling openapi_url when CLINIC_DEBUG=false.

title: Logout endpoint is state-changing but does not require CSRF
remediation: Require CSRF on logout or document accepted logout-CSRF behavior. Fixed in fix/application-security-hardening by requiring an active session and session-bound CSRF token before logout.

title: Rate limiting is login-focused and per-process only
remediation: Add persistent or deployment-level throttling for login and heavy endpoints. fix/application-security-hardening adds bounded in-memory controls for selected heavy/search endpoints; persistent/deployment throttling remains future work.

title: Repository lacks visible CI workflows and branch protection baseline
remediation: CI, dependency audit, Bandit, Gitleaks, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS and SECURITY.md are added in fix/github-security-baseline. Apply protected main, required reviews/checks and no-direct-push settings in a separate post-merge step.

title: Request schemas generally ignore unknown JSON fields
remediation: Use strict Pydantic models with extra='forbid'. Fixed in fix/application-security-hardening for production request schemas, with explicit import/export compatibility fields.

title: PHI at rest relies on filesystem and disk controls, not application encryption
remediation: Encrypted backup packaging and key validation are implemented in fix/backup-security. Enforce disk or volume encryption for live SQLite, WAL/SHM, swap, crash dumps, and snapshots; SQLCipher/application-level DB encryption remains separate.

title: GitHub Advanced Security and vulnerability-alert settings were not verifiable
remediation: Repository owner should verify Dependabot alerts, dependency graph, secret scanning, push protection, and code scanning.
